// diagnostic E0149

Jet.RuntimeStringAsCheckedText

A runtime `String` used where a checked text type is expected

What

A runtime `String` used where a checked text type is expected

Why

A checked text type is built only from checked literals, so untrusted text can't change its meaning

Fix

Use `Type.from(text)` to construct the checked text value before using it.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.RuntimeStringAsCheckedText: Tests/UI/db_typed_sql_all_sinks_plain_string.stderr.

Error: Jet.RuntimeStringAsCheckedText: A runtime `String` can't be used as `SQL`
  --> Tests/UI/db_typed_sql_all_sinks_plain_string.jet:8:24
    |
  8 |     _rows: scope.query(text)
    |                        ^^^^
 Why: `SQL` is checked text, built only from a checked literal whose `{value}` holes its `CheckedText` impl encodes, so untrusted text can't change its meaning
 Fix: Write `SQL{"..."}` with `{value}` holes, or use `SQL.raw("…")` if you have audited the text
